name: Céline Imart - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) No 1308/2013, (EU) 2021/2115 and (EU) 2021/2116 as regards the strengthening of the position of farmers in the food supply chain
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on new EU rules to give farmers more power in the food chain. It wants written contracts for more farm products, clearer rules for labels like "fair" and "short supply chain", and stronger producer groups that can negotiate prices together. It also asks for price reviews that reflect real production costs, and for support money not to be taken from farmers' direct payments.

- Written contracts become the norm for more farm deliveries, with a small-value exemption.
- Producer groups get more room to negotiate together; farmers gain more say over labels.
- Parliament's position now goes to EU governments for negotiation on the final text.
